test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper purchased 1600 mangoes at the rate of ₹120 per dozen. Out of these, he sold 900 mangoes at ₹15 per mango and the remaining mangoes at ₹14 per mango. His gain percentage is:
solution:
**Given:**

Total quantity of mangoes = 1600

Cost price of mangoes = Rs.120/dozen

**Formula used:**

Gain = (S.P - C.P)

Gain% = (P × 100)/C.P

Where, P = profit; C.P = cost price; S.P = selling price

**Calculation:**

Price of 12 mangoes = 120

Price of 1 mango = 120/12 = 10

Total C.P = 1600 × 10 = Rs.16000

Total S.P = 900 × 15 + 700 × 14

⇒ 13500 + 9800 = 23300

Gain = (23300 - 16000) = Rs.7300

Gain% = (Gain × 100)/C.P

⇒ (7300 × 100)/16000 

⇒ 730/16 = 45.625%

**∴ The correct answer is 45.625%.**
